turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I might play some guitar tonight if my hands aren't too tired. I'll probably skip the climbing gym today though, since I want to just relax after this presentation.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Completely fair. Good luck with the big account meeting! I'm sure you'll do great. Let me know how it goes.

turns.speaker: user
